description: มุน 2026-07-28: extracted the big-blue habit-card into a shared <HabitCard/> (Zone 4 โหมดเซียน 333:6889 === Zone 6 เรียนปาจื่อ 375:14151 — pixel-identical, only title/CTA differ) and gave it the Figma 3-element idle cohort (get_motion_context: loop 2000ms, one easing cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1)): .hc-big mascot scale 1->1.04->1 + y (wrapper animates scale+y only; the flip/rotate that orients the mascot lives on an INNER static child, so reduced-motion leaves it correct), .hc-small sprite rotate -151.216 +/-5 + y (base flip/rotate on the class), .hc-frame book rotate -9.154 oscillate + y (base rotate on the class). transform-ONLY (no margin/top -> no CLS, ตู๋'s rule). Bug-class the anchor owns (pixels lie about motion): (1) motion silently never attaches -> a reduced-motion guard passes VACUOUSLY (มุน hit this live on Zone 3); (2) reduced-motion strips the BASE transform not just the animation -> the sprite un-flips/un-tilts at rest (the exact #128 bug, now guarded on the SHARED card); (3) the cohort drifts out of sync (different duration/easing); (4) the motion thrashes the main thread (someone animates top/margin -> jank+CLS). The anchor asserts the INSTRUMENT BOTH ways (getAnimations reads NON-empty when motion should run AND empty under reduce — else the guard is vacuous) and measures jank at 4x CPU throttle (0 long tasks, rAF p95 18ms/120 frames — transform-only compositor path). It deliberately does NOT assert keyframe values match Figma degree-for-degree (that is ฟีม's eye). The team-flagged 'not-free' cost was PAID and EARNED its keep: the before/after pixel-diff (Zone 4 under reducedMotion, main vs branch) caught a REAL regression the anchor cannot — my first hc-small keyframe wrote "scaleY(-1) rotate()" (scale-then-rotate) while the merged/Figma Tailwind "-scale-y-100 rotate-[-151.22]" emits "rotate() scaleY(-1)" (rotate-then-scale); since scaleY(-1)*R(t)=R(-t)*scaleY(-1) the small mascot was MIRROR-reflected (3439px/0.51% changed, whole sprite). Fixed to rotate()-then-scaleY(-1) with translateY outermost -> diff dropped to 8px/0.0012% (sub-pixel AA from a 0.004deg rounding). run-zone4-sian.ts (the merged static anchor) stays green both before and after the refactor (no Zone 4 regression). gate_layer=visual/motion. ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-07 (goo · harness-tidy ใบ ข · on บอง’s ruling): the anchor named here was MOVED to harness/archive/ — nothing runs it (not CI, not an npm script), so the field was advertising a guard that does not run (the shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191). Rule: connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor FILE is kept in harness/archive/ (Rule 1 · Nothing is Deleted); to revive, wire it into CI first, then re-add enforced_by. WAS: harness/run-zone4-motion.ts#mut-reduce-kills-transform
